steps: Boil the potato until just tender, then cool, peel and cut into small cubes.
Simmer the tamarind and jaggery in a little water with the cumin, chilli powder and a pinch of salt until thick; let it cool and strain.
Blend most of the coriander with the mint, the green chilli, a squeeze of lemon and a spoon of water into a thick green chutney.
Chop the onion and tomato finely, and toast the puffed rice in a dry pan if it has gone soft.
Put the puffed rice, potato, onion, tomato and peanuts in a big bowl and sprinkle over the chaat masala.
Add both chutneys a little at a time, tossing gently so the puffed rice stays crisp.
Crush in the papdi, squeeze over the rest of the lemon and toss once more.
Top with the sev and the last of the coriander and eat straight away.
note: Now that sev, papdi and peanuts are in the pack, puffed rice goes back down to 20 g a bowl. Both chutneys are made from scratch at roughly one spoon each a serving; the hot red garlic chutney is left out, as chilli powder covers it.
